capabilities.summary: Failed-boot detection after an app update: a sentinel file, BootStage progress and the reinstall decision (no payload backup, no rollback, per decision D1 of #771)
policyNotes: Declaration-only: apps call this crate instead of keeping their own boot sentinel, boot attempt counter or boot_stage and boot_ok commands.
Pure policy plus one sentinel file; it restores nothing and installs nothing.

capabilities.summary: A webview fetch request executed natively through rightkit-http: exact https host allowlist, optional path prefixes, redacted errors, base64 body DTOs
policyNotes: Declaration-only: replaces tauri-plugin-http. The webview never carries a policy; the app compiles the allowlist natively.
Registration as a Tauri command stays with the shell host; the JS fetch export is @rightkit/tauri.
